text: …　なに　ロケットだんの　れんちゅうが　おもう　ぞんぶん　ポケモンの　けんきゅうを　させて　くれるって　いったんでね

structure.jp: ロケットだんの　れんちゅうが
おもう　ぞんぶん　ポケモンの　けんきゅうを　させて　くれるって
structure.en: that they'd let me research Pokémon as much as I like

patterns.name: 〜させてくれる
patterns.explanation: させる is 'let someone do', and くれる adds that it is done as a favor to me. けんきゅうを　させて　くれる = 'they let me do research'.

patterns.name: 〜と (quoting)
patterns.span: くれるって　いった
patterns.explanation: って is the casual form of と, which wraps up what someone said before a verb like いう. させて　くれるって　いった = 'they said they would let me'.

patterns.name: 〜ので
patterns.explanation: んで is the casual form of ので, 'because'. Ending the sentence on it leaves the result unsaid. いったんでね = 'because they said so, you see'.
